title: Mistral’s New Frontier Model Weights: Why Local Control Matters for Cybersecurity
description:
Mistral just released the weights for its massive new AI model, letting companies run frontier-level intelligence on their own servers. We’re breaking down what this means for your data privacy and whether on-premises AI is the security upgrade we've been waiting for.

What we covered:
• Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
• Zest launches an AI restaurant concierge you can use by text
• Amazon Taps $80 Billion Supplier Loan Facility to Fund AI Infrastructure

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: If your AI agent could book your dinner reservations and settle group debates, would you trust it to pick the right restaurant?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
